title: Jivein Baba Razi, Hove Sughra Raazi,
body:
Jivein baba razi, hove Sughra raazi, Na holai bay bay roor, meda chacha Ghazi.
<<DIVIDER>>
Main jaane diya pa pande hai tu, Tenu kuch nahin aunday
Jivein baba razi, hove Sughra razi.
<<DIVIDER>>
Aai pur-e musafir vich chacha, je main bemare-e de ga koi nahin,
Jivein nibney-e-zindagi nib-e-vesi, hun main dukhiya de.
<<DIVIDER>>
Teyei choti ya vale virun koon, keya vale vale ke gale laundey main,
Mera hosla dekh me deke-kidiyeh, chun viire-re-de-shaadi.
<<DIVIDER>>
Tu fikr-e-na kur main razi ah, kyoon razi paak imamat da,
Tede saamne kusameh cendie ay, tedey paak-e-wufaday.
<<DIVIDER>>
Upne surdar de-e-kudma vich, mushure teye abar rave,
Tayar-e-mari te gay-yeh cha Awn ne de maadee.
